additional_info.subject: Incident on SiD Y2/R5 313048135001 – Connector 2 fault
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report an issue on the charging station installed at Procter & Gamble Amiens (SICHARGE D, serial no. Y2/R5 313048135001 – code FR*AU10057-01).
The Connector 2 (DC CCS, 180 kW) is in fault with the following message:
•     Vendor specific error
•     VendorErrorCode: secc pilot is E
•     Last status update: 22/09/2025 at 18:26:11
Communication with the charger is established, but the connector remains in fault state.
A restart was performed, but the issue persists.
According to previous reports, this fault seems to be recurring on this connector.
Could you please investigate and advise on corrective actions to resolve the root cause and prevent recurrence?
Thank you in advance for your support.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
